audience: localization teams with a dedicated LingoHub API key

useCases.title: Review translation progress
useCases.text: Find your projects and inspect translation status by locale and resource file.

useCases.title: Inspect localization resources
useCases.text: List the resource files in a project and download a selected text resource for review.

useCases.title: Export current translations
useCases.text: Request a translation export, then check its status and download link.

useCases.title: Upload a reviewed resource file
useCases.text: List the existing files, then upload a resource file when requested. Import settings can overwrite or deactivate translation segments.
